game_concept: A racing platformer set in The Kingdom – Harvest Fields, farm fields beyond the walls: the royal scribe must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected coins into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the drawbridge.
theme: The Kingdom – Harvest Fields: farm fields beyond the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Harvest Fields, repeat each round: Drag collected coins into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the drawbridge. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the royal scribe ahead. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the drawbridge by solving code steps involving crate_b that move the royal scribe forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the drawbridge first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Harvest Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Harvest Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
